description: Frequency-band Graph Attention Transformer (FGAT-NeuroProbe). Alternating temporal and spatial transformer blocks where spatial attention is biased by a learned combination of multiband functional connectivity graphs (theta/alpha/beta/low-gamma/high-gamma). STFT preprocessing with Laplacian re-referencing and z-score normalization. CrossSubject split not supported (electrode sets differ across subjects).
author: Eli Gross
